_comment: New keys for the two-facility-register work (app/doctors.tsx, app/facility/[id].tsx). Flat dotted keys, 1:1 with facility_registry.fr.json. Merge into lib/i18n/locales/*.json under a new `facilityRegistry` namespace. Until merged, every call site passes the same English as `defaultValue`, so EN is already correct and FR falls back to EN — merging is what turns FR on.
_context: care_facilities is the public directory (2728 active listings). facilities is the operational tenant (482 rows). care_facilities.facility_id joins them and only 468 listings carry it, so 2260 listings can be found and phoned but can never publish a clinician or take a booking. These strings say that plainly. They must never imply a listing is connected when it is not.
facilityRegistry.connectedOnlyHint: Show only facilities that can publish clinicians and take bookings
facilityRegistry.allListingsHint: Show every facility in the public directory, connected or not
facilityRegistry.connectedExplainer: {{connected}} of {{total}} listed facilities are connected to OpesCare. Only these can publish clinicians or take an online booking — the rest can still be found and called.
facilityRegistry.allExplainer: Showing all {{total}} listed facilities. Only {{connected}} are connected to OpesCare; the others can be found and called, but publish no clinicians.
facilityRegistry.noConnectedMatch: No connected facility matches that search. The place you are looking for may still be in the public directory — show all listings to find and call it.
facilityRegistry.noRosterBookableBody: This facility is connected to OpesCare but has not published its clinicians. Its appointment calendar is open, so you can book here without choosing a doctor first.
facilityRegistry.connectedFallback: This facility is on OpesCare, so it can publish clinicians and take online bookings.
facilityRegistry.directoryOnlyFallback: This place is in the public directory only. It has not joined OpesCare, so it publishes no clinicians and cannot take an online booking. You can still call it directly.
